title: Dirty Feature Values in Tabular Foundation Models: Reproducibility Software

creators.name: Cai, Siyu
creators.affiliation: School of Computing and Artificial Intelligence, Southwest Jiaotong University

description: Version 1.3.0 adds the fixed descriptive CatBoost extension: 915 input-matched conditions, 595 retained records and 320 corrective refits, 320 saved prediction vectors, metric replay and dataset-first analysis. Original confirmatory test families are unchanged. The preceding v1.2.1 studies remain identifiable; raw feature tables and third-party checkpoints are excluded.
